label: Zyxel GS1900-8
description: Zyxel GS1900-8 - 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, fanless desktop smart-managed switch with no SFP and no PoE (the non-PoE base model of the GS1900 line).

fabric.note: Zyxel quotes 16 Gbps switching capacity and 11.9 Mpps forwarding rate, with a 525 K packet buffer, an 8 K MAC address table and 9 K jumbo frames.

notes: Zyxel GS1900 Series datasheet (dated 16/11/22) https://static.us.zyxel.com/pdf/2024/switch/ds_GS1900-10HP.pdf; specification table https://www.zyxel.com/global/en/products/switch/gs1900-series/specification. Management and switching features from the datasheet feature list and the GS1900 Series User Guide V2.90 Edition 2 https://download.zyxel.com/GS1900-48HPv2/user_guide/GS1900-48HPv2_V2.90_Ed2.pdf. There is NO console port and no CLI anywhere in the series: management is the web GUI, SNMP v1/v2/v3, RMON 1/2/3/9, syslog, LLDP/LLDP-MED, 802.1x, RADIUS and TACACS+, which is why no device here declares cli. Eight-port model: total port count 8, all 100/1000 Mbps RJ45, no SFP, no PoE, 5.0 W maximum consumption, 250 x 104 x 27 mm, 0.65 kg, fanless (0 dBA). The datasheet ordering table lists GS1900-8-EU0102F / -US0102F at hardware revision B1 as the current build.
